How to progress

  1. 1

    Pick a weight you can lift for the bottom of the rep range.

  2. 2

    Reach the top of the range on every set, then go heavier next time.

  3. 3

    Miss the range two sessions in a row? Go a little lighter.

Let Grasp run this plan for you

Grasp builds each session and sets your next weights. Free, no ads.

Questions

Can I swap an exercise?

Yes. Pick one that works the same muscles: each exercise page lists similar, easier and harder versions.

How heavy should I go?

Heavy enough that the last reps of each set are hard but your form holds.

Do I need a warm-up?

A few minutes of light movement and one lighter set of the first exercise is enough.
